1.title: Entering Divine Service in Haste
1.summary: The first entry into divine service must be seized in haste like Pesach Mitzrayim, escaping bodily desires at the moment of awakening; afterward one proceeds slowly and deliberately like Pesach Dorot.

2.title: Blessings and Awareness of the Divine
2.summary: A blessing's essence is knowing Whom one addresses, dedicating every deed to God; Berakhot opens the Talmud because knowing God precedes serving Him, and its second-person opening reflects God's direct presence.

topics.en: In All Your Ways Know Him

3.title: The Yoke of Heaven by Day and Night
3.summary: Shema's acceptance of Heaven's yoke is framed by lying down and rising because the need arises within man: by day to direct all labor Heavenward, by night to stay conscious of God in passivity.

sefariaTopics.title: Laws of the Recitation of Shema

4.title: The Primacy of the Evening Acceptance
4.summary: A boy's first obligation at thirteen is the evening Shema, teaching that one accepts Heaven's yoke from darkness and ignorance first, and only afterward merits the illuminated service of day.

sefariaTopics.title: Laws of the Recitation of Shema

5.title: The Sustained Continuity of the Yoke
5.summary: The yoke of Heaven must never depart even momentarily: at night it is carried throughout one's lying down, while by day the acceptance at the moment of rising sanctifies all subsequent activity.
keyTerms: על חטא שחטאנו לפניך בפריקת עול
אשרי אדם לא יחשוב השם לו עון

6.title: The Sequential Stages of Accepting the Kingdom
6.summary: Complete acceptance of Heaven's kingdom proceeds in stages: cleansing from base desires, washing away self-interest, bearing God's seal in tefillin, declaring the yoke in Shema, and finally standing face-to-face in prayer.
keyTerms: מניח תפילין וקורא קריאת שמע ומתפלל

7.title: The Spiritual Significance of Meal Times and Shema
7.summary: The times for Shema are tied to meal times because accepting Heaven's yoke sustains spiritual life as food sustains the body; halakhah follows the Kohanim, whose holy eating demands prior purification.
keyTerms: משעה שהעני נכנס לאכול פתו במלח
משעה שבני אדם נכנסין לאכול פתן בערבי שבתות

8.title: Preparation, Prayer Windows, and the Obscurity of Night
8.summary: Preparation for prayer varies by person; the evening prayer was optional and extends until dawn because night, like this concealed world, obscures the face-to-face clarity that prayer demands more than Shema.
keyTerms: חסידים הראשונים היו שוהין שעה אחת

9.title: The Gravity of Passive Omission
9.summary: Idly failing to perform an obligatory mitzvah counts as an active transgression, as the Mishnah's phrase 'to distance man from transgression' and the skull that never wore tefillin show.
keyTerms: כדי להרחיק את האדם מן העבירה

10.title: Anchoring Study in the Divine Word
10.summary: All Torah study must stand anchored on the Scripture God commanded, kept constantly before one's eyes, as the Mishnah's opening 'From when' rests on a verse, unlike secular disciplines.

11.title: We Learn from the Creation of the World That in All Matters the Night…
11.summary: As at Creation, night precedes day in all things, for absence precedes existence and peel precedes fruit; only in the realm of holiness (kodashim) does day come first.
keyTerms: כי אשב בחושך השם אור לי

sefariaTopics.title: Laws of the Recitation of Shema

12.title: Regarding Repentance, There Are Two Facets
12.summary: Repentance has two facets: resolve for the future, which instantly makes one righteous and fit to accept Heaven's yoke after the sun sets on his defilement, and atonement for the past, required for holiness.
keyTerms: ולרשע אמר אלהים מה לך לספר חקי
אלמלא הקדוש ברוך הוא עוזרו אין יכול לו

13.title: Time Is Composed of Day and Night
13.summary: Life, like time, alternates between day and night; in the dark one searches the heart's crevices by the candle of mitzvah, while daylight purifies until sunset completes the purification.

14.title: Even During the Day There Are Times When Clouds Obstruct Direct Light Without Bringing…
14.summary: Clouds that veil the sun's direct light are mostly beneficial, shielding from blinding intensity and bringing growth-giving rain, yet they harm when full heat is needed to complete the harvest.

15.title: A Mitzvah Is a Spiritual Privilege When It Presents Itself to a Person
15.summary: A mitzvah that comes one's way is a privilege, so the zealous enter it the moment its time arrives; accepting Heaven's yoke through Shema and prayer is the essential preparation before every mitzvah.

16.title: A Mitzvah Performed on Account of Doubt Certainly Bears the Holiness of the Blessed…
16.summary: A mitzvah fulfilled because of doubt carries genuine holiness, for a doubtful obligation is treated as certain; whatever stringency Israel adopts as a mitzvah truly becomes a mitzvah.

17.title: The Working Hours of a Laborer Are Exclusively by Day
17.summary: Divine service, like a laborer's work, belongs to the day; the night is for sleep and for guarding against sin, the protective function of the negative commandments.
keyTerms: יצא אדם לפעלו ולעבודתו עדי ערב
השמר פן ואל אינו אלא לא תעשה

18.title: The Evening Acceptance of Heaven's Yoke
18.summary: The evening Shema, though phrased as 'when you lie down,' essentially belongs to the night itself, for reclining is the posture of darkness and withdrawal from labor, while day is for active service.

sefariaTopics.title: Laws of the Recitation of Shema
Laws of Eating the Priestly Tithe

19.title: In All Matters and in the Division of Times Embedded within the Fabric Of…
19.summary: Earthly kingship and its divisions of time mirror the Kingdom of Heaven; the three night watches, at which God roars over the exile, call the God-fearing to awaken and lament.
keyTerms: על כל משמר ומשמר יושב ושואג כארי

20.title: "There Are Watches in the Heavens"—referring to Celestial Spiritual Matters
20.summary: The three night watches model divine service: the braying donkey is the body's burden of mitzvot (action), the barking dog is desperate prayer (speech), and the nursing infant is Torah study (thought).
keyTerms: יותר ממה שהעגל רוצה לינק פרה רוצה להניק

21.title: An Awakening from Below in the Service of Hashem Arouses a Corresponding Movement Above
21.summary: An awakening from below in serving God arouses a corresponding movement Above, as when God recites a teaching in a sage's name; souls below are aroused according to the Talmud's earthly signs.
keyTerms: קודשא בריך הוא אומר שמעתתא מפומיה דרבי מאיר

22.title: The Night Comprises Three Distinct Watches and Divisions of Time
22.summary: The night's three watches teach those who understand the times to divide every spiritual night, including the long exile, into three distinct developmental phases.

23.title: In Every Divine Act of the Blessed Name There Is an Identifiable Sign Reflected…
23.summary: Every divine act has a sign below: God's roar in the first watch of exile stirs only the donkey, the second stirs dogs and heralds Elijah at midnight, the third awakens humans to love.
keyTerms: הנה אנכי שולח לכם את אליה הנביא

24.title: During the First Watch of the Night the Donkey Brays
24.summary: The night's signs measure sleep: the donkey brays while people retire, the untethered dog is the heart awake in prayer, and sleep lasts one watch or, per Rambam, eight hours.

25.title: During the Second Watch Dogs Cry Out
25.summary: Like the deep sleep of the second watch, the heart must be asleep to worldly affairs: pray in seclusion free of self-conscious motives, directing even petitions like 'bless this year' solely toward Heaven's needs.
keyTerms: וכל אדם לא יהיה באהל מועד

26.title: During the Third Watch an Infant Nurses and a Woman Converses with Her Husband.…
26.summary: The third watch's nursing infant and conversing woman depict Israel's leaders suckling Torah from Knesset Yisrael while the Shechinah speaks through them; whether leader or generation comes first depends on perspective.

27.title: At the Beginning of the Day and Likewise at the Beginning of the Night
27.summary: At the onset of day and night, world-time's transitions, God roars over the destruction because redemption has not yet come; therefore one should pray then over the exile, inner and outer alike.

28.title: "One Who Sleeps in a Dark House"
28.summary: The sleeper in a dark house is one without inner light who cannot sense the time for accepting Heaven's yoke; he should first seek light himself, else bind himself to the community and its leaders.

29.title: The Destruction of the Inner Temple Comes First
29.summary: Sin ruins the heart first, then the mind, then exiles the limbs, mirroring Temple and exile; repentance reverses this, rectifying intellect and heart before deeds, as rebuilding Jerusalem precedes gathering the dispersed.

30.title: Even an Action That Is Not Inherently Proper
30.summary: Elijah let Rabbi Yosei finish praying in the ruin rather than interrupt him, teaching that one does not stop a person mid-mitzvah performed with proper intent even if a better way existed.

sefariaTopics.title: Rabbi Yose b. Chalafta and His Son, Rabbi Yishmael
sefariaTopics.heTitle: רַ' יוֹסֵי בֶּן חֲלַפְתָּא וּבְנוֹ רַ' יִשְׁמָעֵאל

31.title: One Should Not Pray in a Place Where One Might Become Confused or Interrupted…
31.summary: Where interruption or confusion threatens, pray a shortened prayer with true intent, for a little with concentration surpasses much without; when worldly 'wayfarers' of the heart intrude, focus on brief, heartfelt prayer.
keyTerms: טוב מעט בכוונה מהרבות שלא בכוונה

sefariaTopics.title: Rabbi Yose b. Chalafta and His Son, Rabbi Yishmael
sefariaTopics.heTitle: רַ' יוֹסֵי בֶּן חֲלַפְתָּא וּבְנוֹ רַ' יִשְׁמָעֵאל

32.title: "One Does Not Enter a Ruin" (Berakhot 3a)—meaning a Place Devoid of the Dwelling…
32.summary: 'Do not enter a ruin' means avoid places empty of holiness and mitzvot: suspect hidden desire, fear the evil inclination's foothold, and distrust their instability; serve God on the open King's highway instead.

sefariaTopics.title: Laws for the Protection of Life

33.title: Although Zealous Individuals Do Not Anticipate a Mitzvah Earlier Than the Morning
33.summary: Zealous people begin mitzvot at morning, but an urgent, time-pressed mitzvah warrants laboring late into the night and before dawn, as hired workers do for pressing worldly affairs.

34.title: The Entire Night Was Created for Sleep
34.summary: 'Night was created for sleep' refers to the short Tammuz nights; from the fifteenth of Av, the period's midpoint, nights lengthen and Torah study increases, while bedtime extends until the first watch's end.

35.title: One Should Not Enter a Ruin Because Harmful Spirits (mazikin) Are Commonly Found There
35.summary: Harmful spirits frequent ruins because a house exists for human habitation; once empty of inhabitants and belongings, it becomes a place inverted against settlement, which, as Bava Kamma teaches, ruins the building itself.

sefariaTopics.title: Procedures for Judges and Conduct towards Them

36.title: A Person Should Not Enter a Synagogue Alone—this Referred to Their Ancient Synagogues Which…
36.summary: One should not enter a synagogue alone: ancient field synagogues were perilous from harmful spirits, so worshippers waited for each other; whether this applies to urban synagogues, by day or only at night, is analyzed.
keyTerms: מלאך המות מפקיד כליו בבית הכנסת

37.title: "A Woman Is Not Commonly Found in the Open Field" (Berakhot 3b)
37.summary: An open field signifies expansive extension in length and breadth, as in 'make it fit for yourself in the field'; there bodily desires are not commonly aroused, so one need not suspect oneself of impropriety.

38.title: Accustom Your Tongue to Say "I Do Not Know"
38.summary: Matters clear in private thought should be held in doubt once spoken, since man is prone to error; disclose only what is verified to all, while the heart keeps its own certainties.

39.title: Sometimes It Appears to a Person That He Enjoys Heavenly Assistance (siyata Dishmaya) For…
39.summary: Apparent Heavenly assistance does not prove an action good, for Heaven may assist as a trial, as with Micah; since we cannot know our soul's root, pray for mercy that can transform even the root.

40.title: The Ultimate Essence of Repentance Is Reached When Hashem Illuminates a Person's Eyes So…
40.summary: The essence of repentance is when God illuminates one's eyes to see that his sins were encompassed in God's will, so willful sins become merits, as the Azazel goat is a mitzvah only because commanded.

41.title: "I Am the Lord Your God" Precedes "You Shall Have No Other Gods"
41.summary: Contemplation of 'I am the Lord' out of clear faith guards one from 'You shall have no other gods,' for God Himself, not an angel, protects him and His providence is revealed within his mind.

42.title: In Prayer, the Primary Essence Is the Inner Longing and Passionate Desire to Pray…
42.summary: The essence of prayer, like sacrifices, is the heart's own longing to please God: He needs nothing and does not want to be changed, but the very desire to pray is His will.
keyTerms: ולא צויתים על דברי עולה וזבח

43.title: At Times a Person Faces a Spiritual Test of Such Overwhelming Magnitude That It…
43.summary: A trial so overwhelming that sin is unavoidable is deemed complete duress, which exempts from punishment, as with 'passion enclothed her'; yet one cannot testify about himself, as Zimri erred.

44.title: A Person Possessed of Intense Longing for Physical Pleasures Must Not Be Saddened By…
44.summary: One with intense longing for bodily pleasures should not be saddened: he is a vessel prepared for passionate pursuit of truth; the righteous see the yetzer as a mountain because their desire is strongest.

topics.en: Yetzer HaRa as Root of Holiness

45.title: When a Person Has Sinned So Exceedingly That the Path of Repentance Seems Blocked
45.summary: When sin has sealed the gates of repentance, God creates ex nihilo the speech of 'Peace, peace'; through utter lowliness one reaches Ayin and a new creation, and God declares 'I will heal him.'

46.title: And Unto the Wicked God Said
46.summary: Even one called wicked may still engage Torah, for 'whatever the host says, do, except leave'; the Ma'apilim's holy audacity, 'kingship without a crown,' failed only because premature, but prospers in the footsteps of Mashiach.

topics.he: כל מה שיאמר בעל הבית עשה חוץ מצא

keyTerms: העובר על דברי סופרים נקרא רשע
כל מה שיאמר בעל הבית עשה חוץ מצא

47.title: Regarding All the Innate Faculties Planted within Every Soul of Israel
47.summary: No faculty of a Jewish soul is purely evil; every trait has a good side when used according to God's will, misused good traits turn evil, and even Balaam's audacity will be elevated in Israel.

topics.en: Yetzer HaRa as Root of Holiness

keyTerms: כל הכחות הנטועות בכל נפש מישראל
אין לך שום מדה שאין בה צד טוב
ענותנותו של רבי זכריה בן אבקולס

48.title: One Must Not Join with the Wicked
48.summary: One must not join with the wicked even for a mitzvah, as Scripture condemns the alliance with Ahaziah and Yosef refused Potiphar's wife even for the World to Come, unlike righteous Tamar.

49.title: Each Person Must Know That in Whatever Realm His Inclination Attacks Him Most Fiercely
49.summary: The realm where one's inclination attacks most fiercely, and where he has sinned most, is precisely where his unique soul is prepared to become pure and fulfill its particular rectification.

topics.en: Yetzer HaRa as Root of Holiness
Mitzvah with the Limb of Sin

keyTerms: אין אדם עומד על דברי תורה אלא אם כן נכשל בהן

50.title: Concerning All Manner of Salvations Granted by the Blessed Name to Man
50.summary: Every salvation comes either "in its time," when one is desperate and thirsting for it, or "I will hasten it," the cure prepared before the blow; every Jew merits at least "in its time."

51.title: All of Man's Self-effort in Breaking the Inclination Regarding Bodily Desires Is Called Mere…
51.summary: Self-effort in breaking bodily desire is deceitful grace and vain beauty with no permanence; the true foundation is pleading for God's help, as Palti merited miraculous assistance.
keyTerms: יצרו של אדם מתגבר עליו בכל יום

52.title: A Person Must Not Be Astonished If He Sees the Wicked Multiplying in The…
52.summary: Do not be astonished when the wicked flourish; God owns the vineyard, and even a wholly guilty generation can become in one instant the beloved generation of Mashiach through repentance.

53.title: A Mundane Spoken Phrase That Is Habitual in a Person's Mouth and Constantly On…
53.summary: A mundane phrase habitually on a Jew's tongue is actual Torah and reveals the root of his soul, since speech is the soul's foundation; from it one discerns his purpose.

54.title: Section 54 Is Absent in Some Printings and Added Here from Manuscript
54.summary: The core of Jewish identity is bearing the name of Israel: a convert who knew no Torah is a Jew by that name alone, and renouncing it outweighs the three cardinal sins.
keyTerms: עבודה זרה גילוי עריות שפיכות דמים

55.title: The Root of Sins Arises from Forgetfulness
55.summary: Sin is rooted in forgetfulness of the heart rather than the brain; tzitzit and even oaths to fulfill mitzvot renew remembrance from brain into heart so that sin becomes impossible.

56.title: The Blessed Name Gave the Torah Against the Will of Israel
56.summary: God gave the Torah against Israel's will and will rule them so in the future; He sends each person forced stirrings of repentance, prepared through afflictions and awakened by fear from below.
keyTerms: ביד חזקה ובחמה שפוכה אמלוך עליכם
קבלת עול מלכות שמים בעל כרחו
מה ה' אלקיך שואל מעמך כי אם ליראה

57.title: The Anguish of Soul That a Person Endures Over the Sins He Committed Is…
57.summary: Anguish of soul over one's sins is literally the Gehenna for that sin, so one who feels shame is forgiven; even in such sorrow the Holy One called "You" remains with him.
keyTerms: כל העושה דבר עבירה ומתבייש בו מוחלין לו
בני חיי ומזוני לאו בזכותא תליא מילתא אלא במזלא
לא אירא רע כי אתה עמדי

58.title: In a Matter Wherein a Person Is Completely Pure and Harbors No Selfish Interest…
58.summary: Where one is wholly free of selfish interest he is righteous in that matter and no harm befalls him; mishaps and inadvertent sins reveal where the heart is not yet cleansed.
keyTerms: כל מי שהוא להוט אחר בולמוס של עריות

59.title: Torah Is Called an Expression of Guiding the Way (moreh Derekh)
59.summary: Torah is called "guide of the way" because its inner light returns one to good; study not for its own sake yields only "words of Torah," yet leads to study for its own sake.

60.title: Every Type of Grief and Suffering a Person Experiences Through Another Person
60.summary: Any grief one suffers through another person is a chastising rod for his own sin; one must be clear himself before rebuking others, since God brings harm only through the pure.
keyTerms: קשוט עצמך ואחר כך קשוט אחרים

61.title: The Priests Are Termed "Holy"
61.summary: The priesthood is an eternal inherited level of holiness; practical mitzvot and zealous action implant holiness, which means separation from worldly desire to serve Hashem alone.

62.title: There Are Many Spiritual Virtues
62.summary: Each virtue was acquired by a founding figure and bequeathed to his seed, except Torah, which Moshe could not transmit bodily; hence Israel's diverse paths and legitimate disputes.

topics.en: Both Are Words of the Living God

keyTerms: אין עמלק נופל אלא ביד בניה של רחל

63.title: Sons Resemble the Mother
63.summary: Sons inherit the mother's nature and daughters the father's, though habit shapes daughters after their mothers; children reveal the hidden depths of their fathers' hearts.

64.title: At Times a Person Clearly Sees That the Blessed Name Assists Him and Agrees…
64.summary: Visible divine assistance and even miracles prove nothing about one's objective rightness, since Heaven leads a person along the path he sincerely desires; the Torah is not in heaven.

topics.he: בדרך שאדם רוצה לילך מוליכין אותו

keyTerms: בדרך שאדם רוצה לילך בה מוליכין אותו

65.title: A Person Must Surrender His Very Soul to the Blessed Name
65.summary: One must accept death if his life does not match God's will; this is the secret of Tachanun, and Korach's 250 men reached a towering self-sacrifice that Moshe and Aharon had to match.
keyTerms: ולא ילמדו עוד איש את רעהו

66.title: Prayer Is Required for Every Matter
66.summary: Prayer is needed even for what God has already decreed, as Eliyahu prayed for the promised rain; the Sages fixed daily prayer with the power to tear up a sealed decree.
keyTerms: לך הראה אל אחאב ואתנה מטר

67.title: At Every Higher Spiritual Level to Which a Person Ascends
67.summary: At each new spiritual level one must repent anew for past sins, since higher rungs bring finer scrutiny; this scrutiny is the descent whose anguish earns the further ascent.

topics.en: Descent for the Sake of Ascent

68.title: All Forms of Divine Service Performed Through the Bodily Limbs and Their Commandments Exist…
68.summary: Bodily mitzvot are counsels to rectify the heart, God's dwelling; true mastery over the inclination comes not in noisy struggle but in the still small voice, as David slew his yetzer.
keyTerms: לעולם ירגיז אדם יצר טוב על יצר הרע

69.title: When the Nations of the World Receive and Learn Any Good Character Trait Or…
69.summary: Israel prevails over the nations when the nations absorb some good from Jews, as with Achav's victory and Mordechai, from whom the peoples received the fear of God.
keyTerms: אין עמלק נופל אלא ביד בניה של רחל

70.title: In That Very Matter in Which a Person's Deficiency Lies
70.summary: One's true virtue lies in the very place of his deficiency: corruption is rectified through its own medium, as the Red Heifer, the Mother Binah, cleanses the Golden Calf's death-root.

topics.en: Birth of Mashiach at the Destruction

keyTerms: ביום שחרב בית המקדש נולד משיח

71.title: One Must Not Seek or Pray to See the Harm of Any Person
71.summary: One may not pray for anyone's harm, even the wicked, except measure for measure against those who harm others, and only when free of bias, first holding a benevolent eye toward them.

72.title: Perform Supernatural Miracles Through the Medium of Torah
72.summary: Miracles can be wrought through Torah, as by Moshe and Eliyahu, or through prayer, as by Elisha; prayer intervenes more directly, yet what is done through Torah is intrinsically greater.
keyTerms: מניחין חיי עולם ועוסקין בחיי שעה

73.title: When a Person Rectifies the Flaw Wherein He Sinned
73.summary: When repentance is genuine, Hashem Himself arranges the counterbalancing test (teshuvat hamishkal) in which the penitent will not fail, and this providential opportunity is the sign that his repentance has been accepted, as with Gehazi.

75.title: Transgressions within the Soul of an Israelite Are Not an Essential Acquisition
75.summary: Sins in a Jewish soul are incidental like monetary sanctity and can be redeemed onto the nations (Esau), whereas mitzvot are bodily sanctity and cannot be sold; the nations are Israel's ransom.
keyTerms: והוא יפדה את ישראל מכל עונותיו
ונשא השעיר עליו את כל עונותם
אין פורענות באה לעולם אלא בשביל ישראל

76.title: At the Moment of a Person's Stumbling
76.summary: The hour of stumbling is prepared for an equally great good: by inverting the intense desire toward holiness one ascends, as the Flood's hour was fit for Torah and the Destruction's hour for Mashiach.

topics.en: Yetzer HaRa as Root of Holiness
Descent for the Sake of Ascent

keyTerms: ביום שחרב בית המקדש נולד משיח

77.title: Even Regarding an Exceptionally Great Person
77.summary: A lineage flaw bars marriage even to one like Joshua but not to one like Moshe, for the Crown of Torah is open to all and dwells in broken vessels, converts, and the poor.

topics.en: Crown of Torah Open to All

keyTerms: ממזר תלמיד חכם קודם לכהן גדול עם הארץ

78.title: Sometimes Even Through Wicked Children It Is Possible That Some Benefit Sprouts Forth For…
78.summary: Wicked children can purge a father's inner dross if his lineage is severed from them, and hidden good may come through them, as Mashiach descends from Manasseh; Solomon nonetheless prayed against one.

79.title: The Concept of a Spiritual Blemish Above Caused by Sins Operates Along the Lines…
79.summary: The blemish Above caused by sin is like a solar eclipse: the sun is undiminished, but Israel's failure to receive divine light weakens the Heavenly Host, exile being night; the nations cause no eclipse.

80.title: The Spiritual Rectification for Anger Is Change of Place
80.summary: Anger is rectified by change of place (as the City of Refuge, rooted in holy Gevurot), illicit desire by change of deed, and pursuit of honor by change of name, since no kingdom overlaps another.
keyTerms: אין מלכות נוגעת בחברתה כמלא נימא

81.title: Sometimes It Is Decreed Upon a Person to Die
81.summary: Death may be decreed because one kingdom does not overlap another; the remedy is uprooting envy and accepting one's light dimmed while another shines, possible through attachment to the Land of Israel.

82.title: When a Person Wanders as a Fugitive and Vagabond
82.summary: Wandering like Cain signals a sin akin to murder, such as shaming another or wasting seed; settling down marks rectified deed, but thought is rectified only when the grace of the place rests on him.

83.title: Just as in the Acquisitions of This World There Are Times When a Person…
83.summary: Spiritual attainments, like worldly treasure, can come without labor through Heavenly assistance, as Noah found grace and Israel is found by Hashem; such finds come through distraction, never passive waiting.

84.title: Sometimes There Is One Who Is "swept Away Without Justice" (Proverbs 13:23)
84.summary: A righteous person may perish through his righteousness when others stumble or envy on his account, yet true justice finds some hidden self-regard; the remedy is prayer and divine mercy.
keyTerms: אין הקב"ה חפץ בבריה שמזקת לבריה
ולא תעלה קנאתי על לב אדם

85.title: When a Person Thinks to Himself That He Has Accomplished Much in the Service…
85.summary: One who thinks he has accomplished much in divine service has not begun; arrogance, even in the heart alone like Cain's, comes from forgetting the yetzer hara's stealth, and mastery over it is Hashem's gift.

86.title: Everything That Belongs to a Person's Possessions—his Wife and Children
86.summary: All of a person's possessions, wife, children and animals derive from the root of his soul, so he can reflect on his own spiritual state from them.

87.title: No Decree Goes Forth from the Mouth of the Holy One
87.summary: No heavenly decree is issued without the righteous of the generation unwittingly consenting through their own words, so they must guard their mouths and are struck first.

88.title: There Is No Personal Path That Does Not Contain Crooked Turns
88.summary: Every path has hidden crookedness caused by bodily desires, yet appears straight to its walker; God does not mislead a wholly sincere heart, so error stems from unrectified crookedness.

89.title: Our Sages of Blessed Memory Expounded in Chullin 89a on the Verse "Do You…"
89.summary: The craft of silence means speaking righteousness and stopping at its boundary; Torah heals and frees the tongue so that even a scholar's casual talk is Torah.

90.title: The Torah Is the Architectural Blueprint of the Universe
90.summary: Torah and the souls of Israel are the blueprint of the world, so each generation's Oral Torah novellae bring new souls to light and transform world events.

91.title: All Possessions of a Person Derive from the Sparks of His Vital Soul-force Distributed…
91.summary: A person's possessions are sparks of his own vitality spread through creation, in countless gradations, and are rectified only by returning them to their Source in God.

topics.en: Sparks of the Soul in Possessions

keyTerms: המחדש בטובו בכל יום תמיד מעשה בראשית
בירא דשתית מיניה לא תשדי ביה קלא

92.title: Sometimes Spiritual Levels Are Opened Unto a Person
92.summary: A fleeting illumination that vanishes and leaves one in desire resembles the Flood generation's taste of the World to Come; an awakening from Above still requires repentance from below.

93.title: Initially, the Blessed Name Illuminates a Person, But the Person Is Not Yet Accustomed…
93.summary: An unearned first illumination is easily lost and hard to regain; like the coerced Torah of Sinai and the Second Temple, Torah won through effort in concealment is greater.

94.title: Sometimes a Person Attains an Illumination
94.summary: An illumination first brings fear, a countenance of wrath, which when preserved is rectified into favor and love; frivolity banishes it, for 'panim' always means God's light opening to man.
keyTerms: ושמתי אני את פני באיש ההוא

95.title: In the Days of Youth
95.summary: Youthful passion yields sins of youth (the Flood) or kindness of youth (the Wilderness); the Messiah's generation, the same souls a third time, will transform the evil into good.

96.title: One Who Guards the Covenant and Never Experienced a Nocturnal Emission in His Days…
96.summary: One who guards the Covenant is 'fair of form' like Joseph, yet even gentiles like Og can be clean; Moses feared Og until told Israel alone bear the Covenant's name.

97.title: The Rectification for Emitting Seed in Vain Is Engagement in Torah Study
97.summary: Emitting seed in vain, the 'evil' God created in the yetzer, is rectified by Torah study, the antidote that sweetens evil into 'very good' and atones where sacrifice cannot.
keyTerms: בראתי יצר הרע ובראתי לו תורה תבלין
והנה טוב מאד זה יצר הרע
אין אור של גיהנם שולטת בתלמידי חכמים
לא אירא רע כי אתה עמדי

98.title: Every Verse of Torah Contains the Latent Power and Vitality of That Specific Matter…
98.summary: Every Torah verse carries the living power of its own subject, so tefillin passages, Shema and the Ari's remedy of reciting a prohibition aloud all work through the verse itself.

sefariaTopics.title: Remembrance of the Exodus from Egypt

99.title: A Sign of Complete Repentance Is When One No Longer Remembers the Sin At…
99.summary: Complete repentance is marked by forgetting the sin, because memory itself comes from God, who no longer recalls the penitent's iniquity; until then one's sin remains before him.

100.title: Teshuvah Means That One Returns (meshiv) That Matter Unto the Blessed Name
100.summary: Teshuvah returns the deed to God by recognizing even the sin was His will, so willful sins become merits and the penitent is called God's chasid, beyond strict justice.

topics.en: Beyond the Letter of the Law

101.title: In Practical Deed, It Is Impossible for a Person Not to Deviate Slightly From…
101.summary: No one avoids deviating from strict justice in deed; only in thought and will is one a tzadik, for in supernal Thought even sin belongs to the order of strict Judgment.

topics.en: Beyond the Letter of the Law

keyTerms: אין צדיק בארץ אשר יעשה טוב ולא יחטא

102.title: One Who Conducts Himself with Holiness Even in All Permitted Mundane Matters and Bodily…
102.summary: The chasid sanctifies even permitted matters and the inclination's desires; God therefore sends him stumblings requiring repentance, through which he extracts holiness from evil and becomes 'very good'.

topics.en: Yetzer HaRa as Root of Holiness

keyTerms: אשרי הדור שהנשיא שלו מביא חטאת

103.title: An Entity Created by Hashem
103.summary: Nothing God created is in vain, so even involuntary emission and the demons it forms serve a hidden good; Yosef Sheida reveals Torah like Elijah, and such spirits will be rectified.

topics.he: לא ברא הקב"ה דבר אחד לבטלה

topics.en: All God Does Is for Good
topics.he: כל מה דעביד רחמנא לטב עביד

keyTerms: לא ברא הקב"ה דבר אחד לבטלה

104.title: Within Every Human Being There Exists Congenital Dross Stemming from the Counsel of The…
104.summary: Everyone carries the Serpent's congenital dross; it emerges as emission, wayward offspring or disciples, or is purged through exile and suffering, whose spiritual counterpart is Torah study.
keyTerms: בן או תלמיד שמקדיח תבשילו ברבים

105.title: The Phenomenon of Nocturnal Emission
105.summary: Nocturnal emission can serve as rescue from death, forgiveness, assurance of the World to Come, fertility or Torah success, since Yom Kippur atones for the covenant's blemish in an inverted world.
keyTerms: מובטח לו שהוא בן העולם הבא

106.title: "A Person Does Not Master Words of Torah Unless He Has Stumbled in Them"…
106.summary: Mastery of Torah comes through stumbling: an intellectual stumble brings emission, which after immersion and repentance yields new Torah, as the chasid of Shabbat 127b learned to judge favorably.
keyTerms: אין אדם עומד על דברי תורה אלא אם כן נכשל בהן

sefariaTopics.title: Deciding upon Benefit of the Doubt and Suspicion

107.title: The Rectification for Nocturnal Emission Is Immersion in a Ritual Bath
107.summary: Immersion rectifies emission as a momentary Flood, since the sin springs from the folly lacking Da'at; Torah studied with awe, the waters of Da'at, is Moshe's parallel rectification.
keyTerms: כי יצר לב האדם רע מנעוריו
גם בלא דעת נפש לא טוב
אל אחר אסתרס ולא עביד פירין

108.title: Emitting Seed in Vain
108.summary: Wasted seed blemishes Chochmah above the heart, so ordinary repentance fails; only Torah study in the brain, prayer, and a broken heart reaching Ayin and Keter can rectify it.

109.title: And in the Footsteps of the Messiah
109.summary: In the footsteps of Mashiach this sin surges because pre-Abrahamic souls were grafted into Israel and the three corrupt generations are rectified across three two-thousand-year epochs, the Flood's generation last.
keyTerms: שני אלפים תוהו שני אלפים תורה

110.title: All Offspring of a Person Derive from the Blessed Name
110.summary: All offspring, even those born of wasted seed, derive from God; since no evil issues from Him, the fear of Gehenna is transformed by 'You are with me' into holy awe and joy.
keyTerms: אל אחר אסתרס ולא עביד פירין

111.title: In the Footsteps of the Messiah
111.summary: In the footsteps of Mashiach the task is extracting the precious from the vile: souls rooted in the lowest place of passion merit Mashiach, as the root of evil itself turns good.

topics.en: Extracting the Precious from the Vile
Yetzer HaRa as Root of Holiness

112.title: A Person's Passionate Lust Derives from the Intensity of the Desire of His Father…
112.summary: A person's lust is inherited from the parents' desire at conception; the father's rectification awakens the son to repentance, and the son's repentance brings relief to his parents in Gan Eden.
keyTerms: אין אדם עובר עבירה אלא אם כן נכנס בו רוח שטות

113.title: "The Fruit of the Righteous Is a Tree of Life" (Proverbs 11:30)
113.summary: The righteous engender precious souls, even ones that first appear otherwise; through wisdom, a Torah scholar or God Himself refines such souls from evil into a tree of life.
keyTerms: בנו של רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון
מאריה טבא לא נפיק גור בישא

114.title: Whoever Is a Torah Scholar Gathers Souls and Collects Holy Sparks from Sacred Souls…
114.summary: A Torah scholar's words gather scattered souls and his own soul, but one sunk in evil cannot free himself through his Torah and is saved by others, as Acher was saved by Rabbi Meir.

topics.en: Torah as Elixir of Life or Death

keyTerms: אין חבוש מתיר עצמו מבית האסורים
ולרשע אמר אלקים מה לך לספר חקי
לא זכה נעשית לו סם המות

115.title: When a Person Innovates an Insight in the Torah
115.summary: A Torah novelty born of pure desire for truth is words of the living God even when mistaken, but one born of personal bias, like Jeroboam's or Doeg's, is not Torah and becomes deadly.

topics.en: These and Those Are Words of the Living God
The Merciful One Desires the Heart
Torah as Elixir of Life or Death

116.title: Through Errors Occurring in Words of Torah Wherein One Stumbles and Subsequently Masters The…
116.summary: Stumbling in Torah before reaching truth gathers the captive souls born of the nocturnal stumbling block, since the covenant of the tongue parallels the covenant of circumcision; Isaiah's slip illustrates this.

topics.en: Covenant of the Tongue and Covenant of the Organ

keyTerms: אין אדם עומד על דברי תורה אלא אם כן נכשל בהן

117.title: Whoever Is Pristine and Free from Sins of Passion Requires Extraordinary Vigilance Regarding Anger…
117.summary: One free of sins of passion is prone to anger and bloodshed, their opposite; the seed of Yosef, guardians of the covenant, and Rabbi Yochanan's wrath toward Reish Lakish illustrate this.

sefariaTopics.title: Rabbi Yochanan (Hanapacha) and Rabbi Shimon b. Lakish (Reish Lakish)
sefariaTopics.heTitle: רַ' יוֹחָנָן (בֶּן הַנַּפָּח) וְרַ' שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן לָקִישׁ (רֵישׁ לָקִישׁ)

118.title: One Who Is a Torah Scholar Whose Very Casual Conversation Requires Study (Sukkah 21b)
118.summary: A Torah scholar's casual conversation is itself Torah and rectifies souls; the servants' talk of the Patriarchs surpasses the Torah of their children, and in the sukkah's shade of faith such speech begets souls.
keyTerms: שיחת חולין של תלמידי חכמים צריכה תלמוד

119.title: All the Narratives in the Torah and the Talmud Recounting Wondrous Miracles Performed Contain…
119.summary: Every narrative of a miracle in Torah and Talmud contains the living power to perform it, for holy Names hidden within the verses are keys to those chambers, though the essential allusions concern inner service.

topics.en: Inner Service of Mind and Heart

120.title: One Who Brings Merit to the Guilty Cannot Avoid Having Some Slight Trace Cling…
120.summary: One who brings merit to sinners cannot avoid some trace clinging to him, yet drawing near with the right hand must outweigh pushing away; suppressing or transforming the yetzer depends on each person's path.

topics.en: Left Pushes Away, Right Draws Near
Yetzer HaRa as Root of Holiness

121.title: Throughout the Entire Torah the Sin of Emitting Seed in Vain Is Not Explicitly…
121.summary: The Torah never states the prohibition of wasted seed explicitly, since it also occurs involuntarily; it belongs to derekh eretz that precedes Torah, and its complete rectification awaits Mashiach.
keyTerms: בעל קרי שונה בהלכות דרך ארץ

122.title: We Establish in Shabbat 71a That a Sin-offering Brought to Atone for a Sin…
122.summary: Just as a sin-offering drags along atonement for repeated instances of the same sin, repentance over an involuntary emission drags along forgiveness for willful wasted seed, which is why God arranged nocturnal emissions.
keyTerms: וחשב מחשבות לבלתי ידח ממנו נדח

123.title: And Through the Study of Torah with Diligent, Exhausting Toil
123.summary: Exhausting toil in Torah rectifies wasted seed, since the Sages' death-liability exists only for atonement and slaying oneself over Torah is a spiritual death leading to the Tree of Life.
keyTerms: יפה תלמוד תורה עם דרך ארץ

124.title: The Prohibition Against Emitting Seed in Vain Is Subsumed within the Positive Commandment Of…
124.summary: Since wasting seed is a prohibition implicit in the mitzvah of procreation, performing procreation in holiness with the same limb rectifies the sin and restores the holy spirit to the heart.

125.title: Giving Charity to the Poor Is Likewise Effective to Rectify the Sin of Wasted…
125.summary: Charity, which delivers from death, rectifies wasted seed by sustaining souls, but only to worthy recipients, whom God arranges for the one who truly repents and pleads for mercy.

126.title: Whoever Brings Merit to the Guilty Is Likewise Empowered to Rectify This Sin
126.summary: Bringing sinners to merit, as if creating souls, rectifies wasted seed by redeeming captive souls, but only after one's own repentance restores the holy spirit, as David's psalm orders it.

127.title: A Definitive Sign of Complete Repentance and That His Repentance Over This Sin Of…
127.summary: The sign that repentance over blemishing the Covenant is accepted is the opening of divine vision, which a penitent like Rabbi Elazar ben Dordaya can attain in a single instant.

topics.en: Acquiring One's World in One Hour

128.title: When a Person Commits a Transgression Under the Principle of "It Is Time To…"
128.summary: Even a transgression done for Heaven's sake requires atonement, as with Moshe and Esther, so a penitent still needs afflictions, though Heaven mitigates them through substitutions and the bitterness of remorse.

129.title: The Moment a Person Desires to Repent
129.summary: One seeking purity is helped from Above in an expanding cycle, but the accuser rises then, so he must plead for mercy with joy and confidence lined with bitterness, like the shofar order.

130.title: Even Though Free Choice Is Granted Unto Man
130.summary: Despite free choice, a person cannot alter his hidden root, yet through repentance and Heavenly mercy God creates a clean heart, and retroactively his true root is revealed as such.

topics.en: Even Though He Sinned He Is Israel
topics.he: אף על פי שחטא ישראל הוא

keyTerms: אף על פי שחטא ישראל הוא

131.title: The Root of the Souls of All Israel Is Derived Directly from the Source…
131.summary: All Israel's souls root in the Source of Life, so God's love is never severed by sin; Balaam's flattery sought to alter that root, but God inverted it into eternal blessing.
keyTerms: כל ישראל יש להם חלק לעולם הבא
ויהפוך ה' אלקיך לך את הקללה לברכה

132.title: In This World, the Primary Foundation Is the Purity of the Heart, as Stated
132.summary: This world's work is purity of heart (Binah, Hei), the World to Come is wisdom of the mind (Chochmah, Yud); a corrupted root needs higher repentance from Chochmah, tasted on Shabbat.

133.title: The Torah Operates Directly Upon the Heart of Man
133.summary: Torah returns a person to good only when it penetrates the heart, which happens through thirst born of felt lack, humility, and fear of Heaven; lip-service Torah like Doeg's remains external.

134.title: Sometimes It Appears to a Person That He Has Already Repented and His Sins…
134.summary: Repentance has no limit: as a person ascends to higher spiritual rungs, sins already rectified re-emerge relative to the higher light, so both forgiveness and renewed remorse are true.

topics.he: כל הגדול מחבירו יצרו גדול הימנו

keyTerms: כל הגדול מחבירו יצרו גדול הימנו
עבירות שהתודה עליהן יום הכפורים זה
זקני תלמידי חכמים כל זמן שמזקינים דעתן מתיישבת עליהן

135.title: One Who Feels That He Possesses No Desire in Heart or Mind for The…
135.summary: One who feels no desire for divine service should cast his burden on Hashem; humble recognition of his lack, after lower repentance for deeds, draws new holy desire from Ayin.

sefariaTopics.title: Distinctiveness of the Land of Israel

136.title: When a Person Prospers and Fortune Smiles Upon Him
136.summary: Worldly success means a person is momentarily judged righteous in all worlds, yet such standing may be temporary and later revealed as never genuine, as with Doeg.

137.title: When a Person Sees That All the Good Thoughts and Noble Aspirations Entering His…
137.summary: When good thoughts and aspirations vanish as soon as they arise, one should cast the burden on Hashem, recognizing that the concealment itself comes from Him, who then sustains him through Torah.
keyTerms: השלך על ה' יהבך והוא יכלכלך
המשתף שם שמים בצערו כופלין לו פרנסתו

138.title: Sometimes a Person Sees That He Yearns and Longs for the Service of Hashem…
138.summary: One who yearns deeply for divine service yet fails in physical action does not truly fall; like David with the Temple, heartfelt desire is ultimately actualized, while lip-service alone falls.

139.title: All Actions and Spiritual Labors Are Recognized Only at the End
139.summary: Every deed and spiritual effort is judged only by its final outcome, hidden even from the person himself; the remedy is persistent hope in Hashem through prayer, which secures an uninterrupted inheritance.
keyTerms: קוה אל ה' חזק ויאמץ לבך

140.title: As Long as a Person Has Not Reached Spiritual Perfection
140.summary: Before reaching perfection, a person's own judgments are the inverse of truth; only Torah, which is truth, reveals the true end, and as dreams follow the mouth, Torah words turn deeds to good.

topics.he: במקום שמחשבתו של אדם שם הוא כולו

keyTerms: עצה שיש בה דבר ה' היא תקום

141.title: The Spiritual Concealment That Befalls a Person Seemingly Appears as Proof That the Yearning…
141.summary: Spiritual concealment does not prove earlier yearning false; recognizing the concealment and pleading for light is humility, through which, like Moshe, one's yearning becomes an uninterrupted inheritance.

142.title: Even Though in the Affairs of This World a Person Must Not Rely Upon…
142.summary: In spiritual matters one may rely on a miracle: even when his sins seem to foreclose hope, he should trust in Hashem, who can overturn his heart and even recreate it from nothing.
keyTerms: גול על ה' דרכך ובטח עליו והוא יעשה

143.title: When a Person Begins to Enter Into Torah Study and the Service of The…
143.summary: At the start of Torah study and divine service Hashem grants a great illumination that later recedes; the remedy is prayer, David's rung, which asks that the light not depart.
keyTerms: אור שברא הקדוש ברוך הוא וגנזו
שמרה זאת לעולם ליצר מחשבות לבב עמך

sefariaTopics.title: Laws of the Sanctity of the Temple

144.title: In the Place Where a Person's Thought Is
144.summary: A person is wholly where his thought is, since the soul is the faculty of thought; constant meditation on God's unity or on Torah transforms one's entire being, as shown by procreation.

topics.he: במקום שמחשבתו של אדם שם הוא כולו

keyTerms: במקום שמחשבתו של אדם שם הוא כולו
אין אור של גיהנם שולטת בתלמידי חכמים

145.title: In Every Action of Man
145.summary: In every deed the act is the body and the thought its soul: an unintended act is empty, evil thought is not joined to deed, and delight in mitzvot earns the World to Come.
keyTerms: מחשבה רעה אין הקדוש ברוך הוא מצרפה למעשה
אשריך בעולם הזה וטוב לך לעולם הבא

146.title: Fear and Awe (yirah) Are That Which Fence in and Constrain the Body
146.summary: Fear of Heaven fences in and guards the body, earning reward in this world, whereas wisdom flows from the brain toward the World to Come, as seen in beauty, Written and Oral Torah.

topics.en: This World and World to Come

keyTerms: אשריך בעולם הזה וטוב לך לעולם הבא
אי הוו סנו טפי הוו גמירי

147.title: Through Awe and Fear of Heaven a Person Merits Children
147.summary: Holy awe and shame exercised within one's generative power, acting only for God's will, merit children, for Israel alone grasp that purity and holiness can emerge from the bodily act the Serpent defiled.
keyTerms: יראתי מתוך שמחתי ושמחתי מתוך יראתי
מי יתן טהור מטמא לא אחד

148.title: There Is a Torah Scholar Who Merits That His Teachings Are Widely Disseminated Throughout…
148.summary: Torah teachings may be spread in anyone's name, even Balaam's, Doeg's or Acher's, but one needs divine mercy for Torah to be absorbed into the heart, for God desires the heart.

149.title: A Person's True Spiritual Perfection Is Reached When He Actually Embodies the Perfection That…
149.summary: True perfection is embodying what one grasps: each soul-root is its own world, and only through long toil does Torah vision become an internalized acquisition, 'acquiring one's world' as at death.

150.title: When the Holy One, Blessed Be He, Exalts a Particular Good Quality in The…
150.summary: When God exalts a holy trait, its counterpart in the Sitra Achra sinks and vice versa; thus Egypt's and Tyre's downfalls raised the Written and Oral Torah, as Sodom's fall heralded Isaac.

151.title: Periods of Spiritual Descent Which a Person Experiences
151.summary: Periods of spiritual descent and slackness in Torah, like Rephidim before Sinai, prepare a great ascent when one recognizes his lowliness and cries out to God, as clouds' darkness yields rain.

topics.en: Descent for the Sake of Ascent

keyTerms: המכסה שמים בעבים המכין לארץ מטר

152.title: In Proportion to a Person's Distancing of Himself from Evil—meaning from All Worldly Delights…
152.summary: Withdrawal from worldly desire and nearness to God grow in proportion: fear of sin empties the heart into a vessel which God fills with wisdom, each increasing the other from a needle's-eye opening.
keyTerms: פתחו לי פתח כחודו של מחט

153.title: The Anguish of Soul That a Person Endures Over His Iniquities Substitutes for Physical…
153.summary: Heartfelt anguish over one's sins, awakened through Torah, replaces bodily suffering, for the spark of Mashiach within each soul bears grief for iniquity until it shines as holy delight.

154.title: Just as a Person Is Required to Believe in the Blessed Name
154.summary: Just as one must believe in God, one must believe in himself, that his soul stems from the Source of Life and God delights in him, as Israel believed in Moses, their collective soul.
keyTerms: שבן לילה היה ובן לילה אבד

sefariaTopics.title: The Faith of the Generation of the Desert

155.title: A Person's Honor in This World Corresponds to His Purity in Mundane, Permitted Pursuits
155.summary: Honor in this world follows purity in permitted worldly acts, the garments of Torah and mitzvot; in Gan Eden deeds and intentions become garments, until the World to Come reveals each soul's naked essence.
keyTerms: ערבה אין בה טעם ואין בה ריח

156.title: The Rectification for Nocturnal Emission
156.summary: The rectification for seminal emission (keri) is complete faith that nothing happens by chance (mikreh) but all by God's design, which sweetens judgments and rectifies every sin.

157.title: Had There Existed a Person Who Guarded the Covenant Throughout All His Days To…
157.summary: Perfect guarding of the Covenant would confer eternal life, as with Elijah; one who blemished it is rectified only by sincerely surrendering his soul to death, transforming Malchut's Tree of Death into Life.
keyTerms: מה יעשה אדם ויחיה ימית עצמו

158.title: Through the Surrender of One's Soul Unto Death in His Thought in Absolute Truth—wholeheartedly…
158.summary: Wholehearted acceptance of death in thought counts as action, atones like death itself and frees one from a death decree, as David attained by utterly nullifying the idolatrous inclination within himself.

159.title: If a Single Individual Repents
159.summary: One person's repentance brings forgiveness to the world by awakening repentance in the souls bound to his, in the faculty he repented; awakening those liable to death requires the tzadik's own self-sacrifice.

160.title: A Person's Soul Encompasses the Souls of All His Servants and Those Subordinate To…
160.summary: A person's soul extends into his servants, possessions and food, each drawing vitality from his good or evil; hence the gid hanasheh, blood and chelev are forbidden, lest food nourish the roots of sin.

161.title: When a Person Experiences Suffering in a Particular Limb or in a Specific Faculty…
161.summary: Suffering in a limb or faculty marks sin through it; once punished, that limb is rectified and turned to its opposite—blemish of the covenant becomes its guarding, wasted seed yields converts.

162.title: From Every Transgression an Evil Angel Is Formed
162.summary: The angel formed by a sin is vitality that yearns to return to good and arouses remorse; sins exist to awaken repentance (Binah), which transcends the seven lower sefirot and feeds them.

163.title: All Souls Are Bound in One Single Knot
163.summary: All souls of Israel form one rope held by God: sins pull it downward yet lengthen it into more souls, until He finally draws all to Himself and all proves to be for good.
keyTerms: ועמדו רגליו ביום ההוא על הר הזיתים

164.title: In Human Perception, a Penitent (ba'al Teshuvah) Is Not Equal to a Wholly Righteous…
164.summary: Repentance belongs to the Concealed World, so people cannot see the penitent's superiority; like 'hated' Leah who bore the primary offspring, true Torah and souls are born only through stumbling and repentance.
keyTerms: אין אדם עומד על דברי תורה אלא אם כן נכשל בהן

165.title: The Souls of Israel Each Constitute an Independent, Unique Spiritual Level
165.summary: Every soul of Israel is a unique rung within one collective stature; one toils to reach his own level, and above it earlier perfected souls assist him, so later generations need less exertion.
keyTerms: עזרא לא עלה מבבל עד שייחס עצמו

166.title: When a Person Accepts Upon Himself the Yoke of Torah and Enters Under The…
166.summary: Accepting the yoke of Torah demands wholehearted resolve to abandon conflicting desires, yet one whose heart is not yet whole should still study Torah out of love, since not-for-its-sake leads to for-its-sake.
keyTerms: לא זכה נעשית לו סם המות
לעולם יעסוק אדם בתורה שלא לשמה

167.title: Regarding Words of Torah a Person Is Permitted to Feel Fear
167.summary: Fear over words of Torah—dread lest they become deadly—is permitted and sweetens continuous study from not-for-its-sake into for-its-sake, since constant devekut is impossible and holy fear constricts one's powers inward.

168.title: A Person's Fears Arise from Sins
168.summary: Fears arise from sins and are themselves the afflictions of Gehenna that sweeten judgment; sins, judgments and afflictions are one reality, which repentance in the heart sweetens at its root, turning fear into joy.
keyTerms: כשם שהמלח ממתק את הבשר כך יסורין
אין מלאך אחד עושה שתי שליחויות

169.title: When Fear of Something Falls Upon a Person
169.summary: Fear that falls on a person is Heaven's signal to pray at once, sweetening harsh judgment at its root before it emerges; Elul's thirty days likewise anticipate Rosh Hashanah's judgment with prayer.

170.title: When the Holy One, Blessed Be He, Desires to Bestow Good Upon a Person…
170.summary: When God wishes to bestow good He first arouses its opposite as distress or fear, so that the person prays and the feared thing arrives inverted into blessing.

topics.en: Share in the World to Come

171.title: There Is a Place Prepared for Distress
171.summary: Places, times and souls 'prepared for calamity' are really prepared for overwhelming divine payment that this world cannot contain, so Tisha B'Av hides the birth of Mashiach and mirrors Shemini Atzeret.

172.title: Just as in Space There Exists the Foundation Stone (Even Shetiyah) from Which The…
172.summary: Place, time and soul each have a root (Temple, Shabbat, the generation's leader) where everything is easily sweetened; the High Priest prepares Israel while Moshe reveals the King's light.

173.title: All Natural Phenomena Fulfill the Will of the Blessed Name
173.summary: Every natural act, including necessary eating and intimacy, fulfills the Creator's will like a flowing river, and from animals such as the frogs we learn self-sacrifice for sanctifying God's Name.

174.title: Through Corruption and Blemishing of the Covenant
174.summary: Blemishing the covenant conceals the light of Torah, as in the ninth plague of darkness, yet by the order of creation darkness precedes light and the penitent rises to a greater light.
keyTerms: אין אדם עומד על דברי תורה אלא אם כן נכשל
העם ההולכים בחושך ראו אור גדול

175.title: One Must Take Heed Not to Cause Pain to Any Creature
175.summary: One is punished for causing pain to any creature even for a mitzvah, since God grieves even over the wicked's downfall; only the attribute of monarchy, rooted in Gevurah, rules by strict judgment.

topics.en: God Does Not Rejoice Over the Wicked
topics.he: אין הקב"ה שמח במפלתן של רשעים

keyTerms: אין הקב"ה שמח במפלתן של רשעים

176.title: When They Build or Establish a New Synagogue or House of Study in Any…
176.summary: Blotting out Amalek, the root of evil, always precedes sanctity of place; hence a new synagogue, like the Temple and the future Mashiach, endures without interruption when evil is removed first.
keyTerms: שלש מצוות נצטוו ישראל בכניסתן לארץ
עתידין בתי כנסיות שיקבעו בארץ ישראל
קדושה ראשונה קדשה לשעתה וקדשה לעתיד לבוא

177.title: In Every Matter There Is PaRDeS (Four Levels of Understanding: Peshat, Remez, Derush, Sod)
177.summary: Every matter has PaRDeS: peshat is physical deed, remez the heart's stirring, derush the mind's insight, and sod the incommunicable personal taste of one's deeds granted to those who fear God.

topics.en: The Merciful One Desires the Heart

keyTerms: כי גלה סודו אל עבדיו הנביאים

sefariaTopics.title: Intent of the Seller and the Purchaser

178.title: All Elevation and Sovereignty in the World Occur Through the Torah
178.summary: All sovereignty, even of gentile kings, derives from hidden Torah; their decrees reveal God's will for a new practice such as Haftarah or Musaf shofar, and once it is innovated their power expires.

179.title: "In All Your Ways Acknowledge Him" (Proverbs 3:6)
179.summary: 'In all your ways know Him' means recognizing that only God acts, even in the strength used to sin; this weakens the yetzer, as in reciting Shema, and straightens even past crooked paths.

topics.en: In All Your Ways Know Him

keyTerms: לעולם ירגיז אדם יצר טוב על יצר הרע

180.title: Even Though Our Sages Stated in Bava Batra 9a: "If One Does Not Merit…"
180.summary: Wealth lost to oppressive rulers atones like the scapegoat, rooted in Yaakov's gift to Esau, yet Yaakov was punished for giving to a stranger and was healed only when his wealth was made whole.

topics.en: Deeds of the Fathers Are Signs

181.title: Every Person Possesses a Specific, Dominant Desire
181.summary: Each person's strongest desire is the very vessel for God's blessing once he returns wholeheartedly and traces that longing to its divine source, as Shevuel's love of money fitted him for David's treasuries.

182.title: The Torah Is Called an Outcry (shav'ah)
182.summary: Torah is called shav'ah because studying God's Names, which embody His will, calls Him to dwell within; Torah joined with prayer's awe becomes a true outcry that brings salvation.

183.title: "Conversing" (Sichah) Denotes Mundane Conversation
183.summary: Sichah is mundane talk and dibbur is Torah; one labors until words issue from the heart, then merits that even casual speech becomes his own Torah, like masters of Talmud.

topics.en: Torah of Hashem and One's Own Torah

184.title: The Beginning of Words of Torah Is Passionate Desire
184.summary: Torah begins with passionate desire, man's free choice, and is then called his own; yet through blessing he recognizes all comes from God, whose Names are the names of Israel.

topics.en: Torah of Hashem and One's Own Torah

keyTerms: הכל בידי שמים חוץ מיראת שמים

185.title: There Are Three Stages for a Torah Scholar: Master, Colleague, and Disciple
185.summary: A scholar passes through master, colleague, and disciple; learning from a master is God's Torah, and after the master's passing fear of Heaven and colleagues, by Heavenly aid, preserve his learning.

topics.en: Torah of Hashem and One's Own Torah

keyTerms: עשה לך רב וקנה לך חבר
הוי דן את כל האדם לכף זכות

186.title: The Essence of Fellowship Is with the God-fearing
186.summary: True fellowship is with the God-fearing: sharpening one another births Binah and novel insights, and like zimun and Sukkot unites opposites through Da'at while awe guards innovation.

187.title: Words of Torah Are Strength to Man
187.summary: Torah gives strength over the inclination as divine aid through master, colleague, and disciple; through desire, awe, and humility one births new Torah, called daughter, sister, and mother.
keyTerms: בראתי יצר הרע בראתי לו תורה תבלין

188.title: There Are Four Levels Among Colleagues
188.summary: Shabbat 63a's four levels of colleagues, from mere gathering to sharpening through dispute, mark a disciple's ascent to greatness, with humility guarding against the arrogance that pilpul risks.

189.title: There Are Two Distinct Modes of Divine Perception
189.summary: God is perceived two ways: through creation, the Patriarchs' vision available to every Jew, and through providence, the Work of the Chariot, Moshe's Da'at accessible only to Torah scholars.

topics.en: Work of Creation and Work of the Chariot

190.title: The Eye and the Heart Are the Brokers of Sin
190.summary: Eye and heart broker both sin and good, corresponding to Yosef's guarding of vision and Yaakov's truth of heart; a generous eye flows from love while envy is an evil eye.

191.title: In Worldly Decency (Derekh Eretz), Even Gentiles Are Vigilant
191.summary: Gentile decency like Esau's honoring parents is not true derech eretz, which means recognizing that all worldly matters come from Hashem; the plagues of arov and dever revealed this distinction.

192.title: Through Bodily Lust, Fear of Heaven Departs, as Written Regarding the Immersion of One…
192.summary: Bodily lust drives out awe, so a ba'al keri immerses in water of Chesed to align desire with God's will and unite love with awe; Torah itself burns away desire.

193.title: Even in Words of Torah Hearing Is Legally Equivalent to Speaking
193.summary: Hearing Torah equals speaking it and requires awe, unlike silent contemplation which is permitted freely; thus David could yearn in his heart for priestly service without sin.

194.title: There Are Four Ascending Stages in the Fear of Heaven Mentioned in Berakhot 22a…
194.summary: Fear of Heaven ascends through dread, awe, trembling and sweat; sweat from bodily toil in mitzvot, especially baking matzah, becomes a river of fire consuming the root of lust in the heart.

sefariaTopics.title: Teachers of Torah and Methods of Study

195.title: Fear Is the Attribute of Knesset Yisrael as Is Known
195.summary: Fear of Heaven belongs to all Israel as their derekh eretz preceding Torah; fear and Torah are female and male which bear fruit together, and in the scholar awe is absorbed within Torah.

196.title: There Are Three Loves: the Love of the Holy One, the Love of the Torah, and the Love of Israel
196.summary: Love of God, Torah and Israel are one; love of God is the unseverable root (Keter), love of Torah and Israel are Chochmah and Binah, and for the perfected, love of Israel precedes Torah.
keyTerms: אהבת השם אהבת התורה אהבת ישראל
אף על פי שחטא ישראל הוא

197.title: There Are Three Ascending Levels in the Love of the Blessed Name
197.summary: Love of God ascends through all your heart, all your soul (devekut, tefillin) and all your might, where love is embedded even in one's possessions, the rare level of Yaakov and Moshe.

topics.he: בכל לבבך ובכל נפשך ובכל מאדך

keyTerms: חמורו של רבי פנחס בן יאיר

198.title: Whoever Loves the Torah
198.summary: Love is reciprocal cleaving: the lover of Torah receives her secrets, the lover of Israel (Aharon, Yissachar) intuits each generation's timely ruling, and the lover of God (Yehudah, Shlomo) receives decrees beyond normative halakhah.
keyTerms: ונשא אהרן את שמות בני ישראל

199.title: The Discernment of Love Is Revealed Through the Three Things in Which Our Sages…
199.summary: A person's love is tested in pocket, cup and anger, corresponding to might (Yaakov, love of Israel), heart (Avraham, love of God) and soul (Yitzchak, love of Torah).

topics.he: בכל לבבך ובכל נפשך ובכל מאדך

200.title: There Are Three Categories of Love
200.summary: Minor love is hidden, great love (Avraham) is a divine gift of fiery passion, and eternal love (Yaakov) endures in adversity; the Shema blessings and the Patriarchs embody these three.
keyTerms: הכל בידי שמים חוץ מיראת שמים

201.title: Surrendering One's Life (mesirut Nefesh) for the Love of Hashem Is Not Limited To…
201.summary: Mesirut nefesh includes even one's neshamah, as Moshe, David and the Mekoshesh showed; the four who entered Pardes illustrate flaws in the three loves, while Rabbi Akiva was whole in all.

topics.he: בכל לבבך ובכל נפשך ובכל מאדך

202.title: In Youth, Passion and Love Surge within a Person, and That Is the Prime…
202.summary: Youth is the time of love, maturity of Torah and awe, old age of settled joy, as in the Patriarchs and Shlomo's books; yet love and fear are only wings serving whole-hearted Da'at.

topics.en: Depart from Evil and Do Good

keyTerms: לא בסבי טעמא ולא בדרדקי עצה
דיוקנו של יעקב חקוקה בכסא הכבוד

203.title: The Illusions and Idle Thoughts of Insignificance in the Mind and Heart of Every…
203.summary: Idle imaginings are like dreams, one-sixtieth of prophecy; a Jew's vain thoughts conceal expanded consciousness from his Chabad root, which only one cleansed of lust can extract and elevate.

204.title: One Who Sets Words of Torah Upon His Heart
204.summary: Torah upon the heart removes alien thoughts; each person's imagination matches his Torah level, and prophecy works through imagination in constriction, unlike Moshe whose heart was pure Torah.

205.title: All Imaginations Are Born in the Heart Where Thoughts Originate
205.summary: Imagination enters the heart through sight and surroundings; Egypt embodies illusion, and Moshe, free of imagination, extracted the good from each of its ten levels until wisdom dissolves illusion.

206.title: All Imaginations and Thoughts within Man Are Rooted in Three Sources: Envy, Lust, and Honor
206.summary: All vain imaginings stem from envy, lust and honor, rooted in the pride of the Shattering of Vessels; humility, the Name Mah embodied by Moshe, rectifies them and expands the vessels.

207.title: Vain Imaginations and False Delusions Act as a Barrier Preventing the Knowledge and Awareness…
207.summary: Delusion blocks knowledge of God, as with Pharaoh; the Exodus and all mitzvot are a liberation from illusion, effected through bodily toil, Torah, and the cry Hashem places in the heart.

208.title: The Primary Battlefield of Man with His Evil Inclination Lies within the Illusions And…
208.summary: The war with the yetzer is fought in the thoughts; whoever overcomes illusion merits prayer as direct perception of the Presence, juxtaposing redemption to prayer, as David's 150 psalms did.
keyTerms: מאן דנצח קרבא יהבין ליה ברתא דמלכא

209.title: During the Time of Prayer Delusions Surge Most Intensely within a Person
209.summary: Alien thoughts surge most during prayer; the pure need no effort to concentrate, while others pray that the Shechinah open their lips, and prayer belongs where Torah expels illusion.

210.title: When Seeking to Concentrate
210.summary: Concentration in prayer means divesting corporeality, bordering on prophecy and unsustainable; cleaving to Torah, which sustains like bread, can be continuous, as the minister differs from the servant.

topics.en: Servant and Minister Before the King

keyTerms: לא ימוש ספר התורה הזה מפיך

211.title: Torah and Prayer Are Both Required Together by Man
211.summary: Torah without prayer breeds self-sufficiency and is not Torah; Torah is a support and light for the deficient who yearn, like eaters of manna, for Hashem to illuminate them anew each moment.
keyTerms: לא נתנה תורה אלא לאוכלי המן

212.title: Torah and Prayer Are Both Designated Solely for One Who Is Deficient
212.summary: Torah and prayer serve the deficient and begin in fear; Torah fills the lack with joy, prayer remains in trembling hope, and redemption is juxtaposed to prayer by pleading from past salvations.
keyTerms: עבדו את ה' ביראה וגילו ברעדה

213.title: Whoever Is Deficient and Pleads for Completion
213.summary: The broken-hearted who pours out his need in plain words is surely answered; like Ya'betz, one must refuse any partial consolation and plead from God's mercy beyond strict desert.

214.title: When a Person Prays for a Spiritual Virtue
214.summary: One should pray for spiritual gifts only within his vessel's capacity; Ya'betz asked for Torah, disciples who enlarge the vessel, retention, colleagues, and protection from sin, in that order.

215.title: The Heart Is the Receptive Vessel
215.summary: The heart, cleansed of pride and envy and bounded by fear of Heaven, is the vessel for blessing; love without awe shatters, as Ben Zoma erred, while Yaakov's synthesis receives all.
keyTerms: עתה ידעתי כי ירא אלקים אתה

216.title: Each Day Contains Novel Insights of Torah
216.summary: Daily renewal of Creation brings daily novel Torah, sought through Shema and prayer; Shabbat's three meals and food, like the manna, carry vitality through which Torah enters the heart.
keyTerms: מחדש בכל יום תמיד מעשה בראשית
לא נתנה תורה אלא לאוכלי המן

217.title: The Essence of Man Consists of the Thoughts
217.summary: Man's essence is his thoughts and desires; the evil man of lust and anger only enclothes the Jewish soul's root, so one prays to be delivered from past thoughts and guarded from anger.

topics.en: Yetzer HaRa as Root of Holiness

keyTerms: אף על פי שחטא ישראל הוא
אין מחשבת עריות מתגברת אלא בלב פנוי מן החכמה

218.title: The Primary Root of the Evil Inclination Lies in Bodily Desire
218.summary: The evil inclination is rooted in bodily desire, so Torah, its antidote, redirects desire and thereby subdues anger, which must stay concealed until one attains Elijah-like purity.
keyTerms: בראתי יצר הרע בראתי לו תורה תבלין

219.title: In Proportion to the Preeminence of Knowledge and Wisdom within a Person
219.summary: Greater knowledge brings proportionally greater illusions, so the 613 mitzvot serve as counsels against the inclination, and grasping a mitzvah's wisdom turns it into Torah that protects always.

topics.he: כל הגדול מחבירו יצרו גדול הימנו

keyTerms: כל הגדול מחבירו יצרו גדול הימנו

220.title: The Remedies Against Alien Thoughts and Musings Are the Mitzvot of Tzitzit and Tefillin
220.summary: Tzitzit and tefillin, earned by Avraham's refusal of worldly gain, remedy alien thoughts: tzitzit as an encompassing mantle of awe that reminds, tefillin as bound cleaving that yields Da'at.

221.title: Forgetfulness Is the Beginning of Evil
221.summary: Forgetting God in thought is the beginning of all evil; Sinai's Voice still calls every prepared heart, which through awe and Binah clarifies that general call into detailed Oral Torah.
keyTerms: הכל בידי שמים חוץ מיראת שמים

222.title: The Blessed Name Calls Unto Man Each Day
222.summary: God calls to every heart daily and one must prepare to heed; the Patriarchs' three prayers—Avraham's standing, Yitzchak's conversation, Yaakov's importuning—mark stages from love through awe to faith.

223.title: Words of Torah Are Like a Sword
223.summary: Torah is a two-edged sword that slays alien thoughts at close quarters, while prayer is a bow whose arrows of heartfelt intention reach the serpent's point deep in the heart.

topics.en: Air of the Land of Israel

224.title: Every Person Must Accept Upon Himself the Yoke of the Kingdom of Heaven Each…
224.summary: Each day one accepts the yoke of Heaven ready for total self-surrender, yet the second Shema paragraph returns one to bounded worldly conduct, since every person needs both dimensions.
keyTerms: הרבה עשו כרשב"י ולא עלתה בידן

225.title: Words of Torah That Pass Through the Heart—meaning That the Heart Feels and Is…
225.summary: Torah becomes a tree of life only when it passes through a heart stirred by fear of sin or burning love; cold intellectual study, like Doeg's or Acher's, is external and does not endure.

226.title: Anyone Can Attain Intellectual Wisdom and Words of Torah Even If He Lacks Prior…
226.summary: Torah wisdom flows daily like renewed Creation even without arousal from below, but the Work of the Chariot is revealed only to one who awakens himself, as the Patriarchs did.

227.title: All Israel Possess Complete Faith in the Blessed Name
227.summary: All Israel inherit faith as Nefesh; through effort one ascends to Ruach (felt truth), Neshamah (wisdom), Chayah (encompassing Keter), and finally Yechidah, the still small voice beyond the inclination.
keyTerms: אלמלא הקב"ה עוזרו אין יכול לו

228.title: The True Essence and Form of Man Are the Nefesh, Ruach, and Neshamah
228.summary: Man's true form is his soul, and against its five levels stand five powers of evil—Ezekiel's three husks and Kelipat Nogah of the permitted, which the holy sanctify and the wicked drag down.

topics.en: Yetzer HaRa as Root of Holiness

229.title: The Commandments Are Divine Counsels for Man on How to Attain Spiritual Perfection
229.summary: The mitzvot are divine counsels matched to each soul-level, as the Ten Commandments pair five within five, from simple faith through Shabbat's sanctified pleasure to honoring the purified intellect and will.
keyTerms: מתנה טובה יש לי בבית גנזי

230.title: According to the Refinement of a Person's Spiritual Stature
230.summary: Leadership follows spiritual refinement: Yitro's four officer-tiers and the Nitzavim groups map five soul-levels, with each level marked by how far the inclination is nullified.

231.title: All Elevation and Authority Derive Through Words of Torah
231.summary: All authority comes through Torah, yet since every Jew holds a unique letter of Torah no one may truly lord over another; hierarchy is a this-worldly need to be abolished in the future.

232.title: All Affairs of the World and All Created Beings Remind a Person That There…
232.summary: Everything in creation exists to remind a person of the Creator; 'I am' and 'You shall have no other gods' root all Torah, and blessings before pleasures guard against forgetting Him.
keyTerms: כל העולם כולו לא נברא אלא לצוות לזה
כל הנהנה מן העולם הזה בלא ברכה כאילו מעל

233.title: To Be Saved from Alien Thoughts and Musings Outside Hashem's Will All Day Long…
233.summary: No one but one who has slain his inclination escapes alien thoughts, even in prayer; envy, the Serpent's root, is foreign to the Jewish soul-root, which bows at Modim of itself.

sefariaTopics.title: Rav Dimi, Brother of Rav Safra

234.title: Regarding Idle Thoughts No Explicit Prohibition Is Found in the Torah
234.summary: Idle thought and deed carry no explicit prohibition since they are beyond full control, but idle speech is prohibited; guarding speech through Torah saves one from idle thoughts and deeds.
keyTerms: מחשבה רעה אין הקב"ה מצרפה למעשה

235.title: One Who Strives to Be Saved from Alien Thoughts and Resolves in His Heart…
235.summary: One who sincerely repels alien thoughts is credited as if he succeeded, and will be helped to actually succeed, provided he speaks Torah, for spoken Torah births will and thought.

236.title: It Is Completely Impossible for a Person to Remain Throughout the Entire Day Upon…
236.summary: Spiritual falls are inevitable; one is lifted through Torah, which needs no standing before the King, and through reciting God's praise 'He supports the falling', which stirs His will to act.

237.title: For Every Single Matter There Exist Counsels by Means of Words of Torah And…
237.summary: Torah and mitzvot, especially Shabbat, restore one who has fallen; the Hebrew servant freed in the seventh year alludes to the inner point of freedom beyond the six years of the inclination's rule.
keyTerms: אלמלא הקב"ה עוזרו אין יכול לו
הקונה עבד עברי כקונה אדון לעצמו

238.title: Sleep Also Is Good for Returning and Awakening
238.summary: Sleep lets the mind depart and return renewed, so one may wake a new creation with heart purified; this comes as ibbur of a tzaddik's soul, earned by a hidden spark of good.

239.title: All the Wicked of Israel Whose Souls Continuously Harbor Dark Schemes
239.summary: Wandering souls of the wicked diffuse alien thoughts into the air; a sage who extracts their hidden good rectifies that soul, but neglect lets it impregnate him, as with Yochanan the High Priest.
keyTerms: יוחנן כהן גדול שימש שמונים שנה ונעשה צדוקי
משל שליט מקשיב על דבר שקר

240.title: The Torah Is a Seasoning for the Inclination as Our Rabbis of Blessed Memory…
240.summary: Torah seasons the inclination even in an impure heart, so a scholar may eat meat and through Torah extract souls reincarnated in animals, while an am ha'aretz is limited to vegetation.
keyTerms: בראתי יצר הרע בראתי לו תורה תבלין

241.title: The Commandments and Good Deeds of a Person
241.summary: Every mitzvah creates an angel that prompts further good thoughts, with passion and intention raising its world; Torah creates souls, while in Israel evil thought is not joined to deed.
keyTerms: הוא שטן הוא יצר הרע הוא מלאך המות

242.title: Repentance Functions Like the Annulment of a Sage
242.summary: Repentance from love, like a sage's annulment, retroactively inverts sins into merits (it'hapcha), extracting the soul-sparks lost through wasting seed, which fear-based repentance can only subjugate; Shabbat is its prime time.
keyTerms: בראתי יצר הרע בראתי לו תורה תבלין

243.title: A Person’s Dreams Are What Reveal to Him the Ruminations of His Heart
243.summary: Dreams expose the heart's daytime preoccupations; the bedtime Shema's acceptance of Heaven's yoke and the verse "Into Your hand I commit my spirit" guard sleep through faith, as truth guards the day.
keyTerms: טוב לגבר כי ישא עול בנעוריו

244.title: Through Proper Sleep Without Bad and Alien Dreams and Ruminations
244.summary: Untroubled sleep yields morning fear of Heaven, which HaMapil requests; David, who never slept and fought the yetzer by subjugation, prepared the Temple, while Shlomo, who slept, transformed evil into good.

245.title: Through the Sin of Youth in Wasting Seed and Nocturnal Emission
245.summary: Wasting seed scatters soul-parts into Kelipat Nogah, breeding alien thoughts; these oppressed souls await rectification through the bedtime Shema, Shabbat, the Jubilee, and the future return of the pious of the nations.

246.title: The Root of All Alien Thoughts Is Haughtiness
246.summary: Haughtiness, cause of the primordial shattering, is the root of alien thoughts and idolatry; yet holy pride, outward dignity with inward humility, begins every ascent, and the Hebrew servant rectifies misplaced pride.

247.title: When Hashem, Blessed Be He, Shines His Face Upon a Person
247.summary: When Hashem shines His face, the heart recognizes that nothing exists beside Him; in exile we retain only the lower level (Ani), while prayer reaches Attah and Torah reaches Hu, prepared by Shekalim.
keyTerms: מעט אור דוחה הרבה מן החושך
הדר בחוץ לארץ דומה כמי שאין לו אלוה

248.title: The Essence of Man Is the Passionate Desire within the Heart
248.summary: Man's essence is the desire burning in his heart, measured by the yetzer; the Patriarchs are called Eitanim for unrelenting desire, Avraham in love, Yitzchak in fear, Yaakov in the truth uniting both.
keyTerms: כל הגדול מחבירו יצרו גדול הימנו

249.title: Desire Has the Power to Bring About That Very Thing for Which One Yearns…
249.summary: Intense desire brings about its object unless divine justice withholds it; Shlomo attained all his desire, and Egypt's desire for wisdom, embedded in its wealth, was borrowed by Israel and returned through Shishak.
keyTerms: בדרך שאדם רוצה לילך מוליכין אותו

250.title: One Person's Victory Over Another Is Likewise Determined by the Magnitude of His Desire…
250.summary: Victory between people follows the intensity of desire; Haman's and Amalek's boiling passion is countered by Israel's shekalim and by Yaakov's acquisition of Esau's fervor, bequeathed to Rachel's descendants.
keyTerms: אין עמלק נופל אלא ביד בניה של רחל
אם יתן איש את כל הון ביתו באהבה

251.title: Through Passionate Desire a Person Becomes a Receptive Vessel
251.summary: Passionate desire makes one a vessel for the Shechinah, each according to his heart, yet in cleansing from evil all Israel are equal, like the sockets, the manna and the Written Torah.
